description: Approves two new commercial buildings at Stonegate Shopping Centre.
Reduces parking by 230 stalls at 3035 Clarence Avenue South.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois questioned tenant engagement and parking adequacy for the new buildings.
Stonegate Shopping Centre tenants and customers are affected by changes.
No public correspondence or gallery speakers addressed Council on this item.

description: Rezones Brighton land from future urban development to residential.
Allows one to four unit dwellings in the northwest Brighton area.
R2 zoning permits narrower residential lots than R1A.

chips.text: Approximately 130 property owners received notice of the rezoning.
Administration received no public feedback or correspondence on the application.

description: Proposes rezoning a Brighton site from FUD(H) to RMTN.
RMTN zoning allows low-to-medium density townhouses.

chips.text: Residents within 150 meters of the site were notified.
No correspondence or feedback was received from the public.
